#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n, m;
    std::cin >> n >> m;
    std::vector<unsigned long> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> a[i];
    }

    int n1 = n / 2;
    std::vector<unsigned long> a1, a2;

    // Generate all subset sums for first half
    std::function<void(int, unsigned long)> sums1 = [&](int i, unsigned long sum) {
        if (i == n1) {
            a1.push_back(sum);
        } else {
            sums1(i + 1, (sum + a[i]) % m);
            sums1(i + 1, sum);
        }
    };

    // Generate all subset sums for second half
    std::function<void(int, unsigned long)> sums2 = [&](int i, unsigned long sum) {
        if (i == n) {
            a2.push_back(sum);
        } else {
            sums2(i + 1, (sum + a[i]) % m);
            sums2(i + 1, sum);
        }
    };

    sums1(0, 0);
    sums2(n1, 0);

    // Remove duplicates and sort
    std::sort(a1.begin(), a1.end());
    auto last = std::unique(a1.begin(), a1.end());
    a1.erase(last, a1.end());

    unsigned long ans = 0;
    for (auto i : a2) {
        auto it = std::lower_bound(a1.begin(), a1.end(), m - i);
        if (it != a1.begin()) {
            --it;
            unsigned long candidate = *it + i;
            if (candidate > ans) {
                ans = candidate;
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
